interpretation.source_checks: Original before and after source receipts, original audit output, and literal guards are preserved. Identity checks themselves execute no native tests.
interpretation.native_groups: Each count vector is copied from an original libtest result after a matching run header. Parent suites may contain killed or exited fixture subprocesses. No sums across groups, lanes, repeated selectors or subprocesses are reported.
interpretation.unqualified_subprocess_headers: Run headers without a matching terminal before the next run boundary are retained as unknown. They are not promoted to passing tests or to failing parent suites.
interpretation.other_literal_result_lines: May include grep reprints and nested subprocess terminals; preserved without adding to parent-suite counts.
interpretation.original_checks: Successful original fmt/lint steps are qualified only for lanes where their commands were read. W1 lanes do not inherit fmt from another lane.
interpretation.kill_cuts: The five original real SIGKILL cuts preserve signal 9 and all original debt, CPU-owner and physical-power-loss fields; this record grants no stronger recovery claim.
interpretation.raw_log_hashes: SHA256 over UTF-8 encoding of the complete decoded job-log text returned by the GitHub connector. This is not a claim about compressed ZIP bytes.
interpretation.numbered_lines: Physical decoded-log line numbers remain stable after removal of timestamps and ANSI prefixes.
interpretation.source_and_binary_scope: Original Cargo commands and emitted build profiles are preserved in job logs. No unobserved ELF hash is inferred for these ten lanes.
interpretation.business_and_full_node_scope: These selected original controls do not replace the independent complete Node library run, actual Host service confirmation gates, or any other source cohort.
